description: Learn about Nevada Assemblyman Rich DeLong, the conservative Republican representing Assembly District 26 in South Reno, Mount Rose, Incline Village and southwest Washoe County. A geologist, natural-resource expert and former small-business owner, Rich brings decades of practical experience to the Nevada Legislature. Explore his record, priorities and work to protect taxpayers, strengthen education, support responsible growth and preserve Nevada’s quality of life.
